summary: Mariposa County lookout run by the California Department of Forestry, established in the 1930s and discontinued in the 1960s; listed as gone, with no site description found.

facts.status_note: firelookout.org lists it as gone; Forest Lookouts says it was discontinued in the 1960s; no removal record found

events.note: Established with a lookout with a structure, in the 1930s; decade only, exact year not given
Lookout discontinued in the 1960s; decade only, exact year not given

evidence.quote: 1930's: Established with a lookout with structure.

evidence.supports: firelookout.org index row: Guadalupe Peak, Mariposa, status gone

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources: a short Forest Lookouts page with three lines of history, and one index row. The page spells the name Guadelope; the index uses Guadalupe Peak. Kind is unknown: the page says only 'with structure' and the index lists the type as Unknown, so no design is recorded. Coordinates in the brief (37.44972, -120.05698) match the index row. Searches for a Mariposa County lookout under either spelling found only unrelated fires, plus Crane Flat and Miami Mountain lookouts, which are different sites and are not used. When searching again, expect Guadalupe Peak in Texas to come up. No corrections proposed.
